title: Reporting Implementation — 4-Report Model
purpose: Defines the executable reporting engine for Framework v2. Moves from 11+ reports per session to exactly 4. Each report has defined generation triggers, storage rules, audience, and retirement schedule.

target_model.current_v1: 11+ files per session (avg 9, peak 29). ~1,227 total report files, 65% unconsumed.
target_model.target_v2: 4 files per session. Every file has at least one defined consumer. Report generation is automated from engine outputs.

report_1_readiness.description: Session gate status, portfolio snapshot, session plan, mid-session drift check.
report_1_readiness.generation_trigger: Session T0 — after pre-flight scan pipeline completes

content.gate_results: Per-item gate verdicts and readiness classifications
content.defect_inventory: Counts by defect class and severity
content.session_plan: Prioritized work plan with batch breakdown
content.portfolio_snapshot: Certified count, uncertified count, by-pack-by-section matrix
content.governance_flags: Learner pool exposure, wrong answer key, registry integrity

report_1_readiness.regeneration: At Tmid if scan artifacts change (drift detection)

report_2_quality.description: Structural defect inventory, content quality assessment, EW integrity, per-item CAQS scores, difficulty distribution.
report_2_quality.generation_trigger: After Quality Board completes review pass

content.structural_defects: Per-item DL-008, DL-026, DL-016 reports with QID lists

report_2_quality.regeneration: After any remediation batch that changes content

report_3_certification.description: Per-item CERTIFY/HOLD/ESCALATE decisions, state transitions, evidence package references, REVISION_HISTORY.md entry data.

content.evidence: File references to scan artifacts and quality scores
content.delta_summary: Items inherited via CertifiedDelta, items newly certified, items held

report_4_governance.description: Session close authorization, portfolio authorization, governance events, defect library updates, reporting compliance.

content.portfolio_safety: Learner pool exposure report, known defects in delivery pool
content.defect_library_updates: New DL-IDs created, existing entries updated
content.reporting_compliance: Count verification — ≤4 reports produced this session

retirement_plan.legacy_reports: ~800 of ~1,227 legacy reports retired. All legacy reports moved to reports/legacy/ without deletion (audit preservation).
retired_categories: Individual agent outputs (findings embedded into consolidated board verdicts)
Forecast duplicates (same forecast in multiple formats)
Wave-specific batch artifacts (consolidated into session-level batch plans)
Per-scan individual artifact files (consumed by engines, not persisted as standalone reports)

retirement_schedule.S830: Soft cap 8 enforced. Legacy files identified and moved. Reporting compliance first measured.
retirement_schedule.S900: Tightened to ≤6. Agent outputs no longer persisted separately.
retirement_schedule.S910: Hard cap ≤4. All BF metrics at v2 targets. Retirement complete.

storage_rules.archival: Legacy files moved to reports/legacy/ with original filenames preserved
storage_rules.retention: All 4 active reports retained per session. Legacy files retained for audit trail — never deleted.

audit_retention.all_certification_decisions: Retained in CERTIFICATION_REPORT + DELTA_LEDGER.json — permanent audit trail
audit_retention.all_structural_scan_results: Retained in scan artifacts directory — 1 year, then archived to legacy/
